description: Wrapper for document.execCommand JavaScript commands used by rich text editors.

members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for bold formatting.

members.name: FormatHeadingCommand
members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for formatting as heading.

members.name: FormatItalic
members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for italic formatting.

members.name: FormatStrikethrough
members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for strikethrough formatting.

members.name: FormatUnderline
members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for underline formatting.

members.description: Returns the JavaScript command string for inserting a link.

members.name: InsertOrderedListCommand
